phase: Day 200 · PM — the autonomy blackout finally has a root cause; five founder gates still open
headline: Day 200, PM — Frankie's Wednesday opens on the first genuinely good news in weeks: the reason the autonomy keeps going dark is finally found. The Mac sleeps straight through the 06:00–06:30 IST cron, so all twelve scheduled tasks fire in one catch-up burst the moment it wakes — and that burst ran this morning's AM brief BEFORE the cofounder sweep it was built to read. The fix is no longer 'investigate' but a two-line founder action: keep the Mac awake in the window, or move both crons to a known-awake hour. Everything else is unchanged, and that is the whole point — on a full business Wednesday the three moves that need nobody's permission are still sitting exactly where the AM brief left them: post Batch 1 (17 days idle, the keystone), call the IRS at 8 AM PT (31 days silent), reply to Mercedes (19 days owed). PM inbox re-check: still zero, newest mail Jun 26.

spotlight.title: Post Batch 1 — 17 days postable, the cheapest move on the board
spotlight.detail: 6–7 reels declared ready Jul 12. Both Pages (Hanflux AI · Oraya AI) have carried real Overview and positioning copy since Jul 19, so the 'the page is blank so they go away' problem the whole plan was built around is already solved — the only thing missing is posts. This needs no IRS reply, no Fable, no compliance clearance, no spend and no third party: two founders mutually pick reels and hit post on personal + both company pages.
